subject: SRE handshake — Observability activation for Raintree Health
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@raintree.ai>; Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@raintree.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SRE handshake — Observability activation for Raintree Health

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. This thread is to align the SRE/ops handoff and the observability activation plan so we can start the implementation sprint next Monday (2027-07-05). High-level goals we discussed:

- Deliver core dashboards for latency/cost/error breakdowns
- Add tracing hooks for user-facing pipelines (inference path and pre/post-processing)
- Define error taxonomy and alert routing (pager vs email vs ticket)
- Provide runbooks for the top 8 failure modes and a lightweight on-call checklist

Attached: initial MVP checklist and a bare runbook template.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday (2027-07-01):
1) 2–3 engineers who will own the Raintree side of tracing instrumentation
2) Any existing dashboards you want preserved or replaced (attach CSV if helpful)
3) SLO targets we should aim for (p99 latency, error rate thresholds)

Marissa — looping you in to coordinate the technical work and runbook drafts. Ben — CS context + escalation path. Priyom — I'll need your help with alert routing and suggested thresholds based on similar deployments.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Raintree_onboarding_MVP_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@raintree.ai>

Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@raintree.ai>; marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SRE handshake — Observability activation for Raintree Health

Diego — thanks, this looks great. Quick answers:

- Owners: Myself (platform lead), Tom (backend), and Michael Park (site reliability) — Tom will be the primary contact for instrumentation.
- Dashboards: We currently have a Grafana dashboard for inference latency that we'd like to keep; I'll export the panel list and send it (attaching a CSV).
- SLOs: Our initial ask is p95 < 350ms, p99 < 700ms for inference requests; error budget policy TBD (we'll propose an internal threshold).

A couple of questions:
1) Can Redwood provide example runbooks for cold-start GPU allocation failures and OOMs?
2) For alert routing, we prefer: critical -> PagerDuty to on-call platform engineers; high -> email to platform + CS; medium -> Jira ticket to triage. Does Redwood support that routing out-of-the-box or do we need custom connectors?

I'll attach the dashboard panel export and our internal runbook template to speed things up.

Best,
Sarah Liao
Platform Lead, Raintree Health
[Attachment: dashboards-request.csv (CSV of Grafana panels)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SRE handshake — Observability activation for Raintree Health

Sarah — great to meet you. A few notes from CS side:

- We generally map "critical" to our Tier 0 paths (inference 5xxs, model serving OOM) and will push those to PagerDuty. Redwood supports PD and can map alerts by rule; Priyom will send the initial recommended routing.
- We can keep your Grafana panels and surface the same KPIs in Redwood Console dashboards for redundancy. Marissa will import the panel list and propose a dashboard layout.
- Runbooks: Diego, Marissa and I have a short library of incident playbooks. I'll share a trimmed set for GPU cold-start, OOM, model rollback, and KV cache corruption.

Action items I can own: gather incident playbook excerpts and sample alert filters; coordinate the first-run kill switch test with your SREs.

--
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-runbook-template.md (markdown runbook template)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@raintree.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SRE handshake — Observability activation for Raintree Health

Hi all — quick technical sketch from the implementation team:

- Tracing hooks: we recommend two lightweight spans in the inference path — "request-serialize" and "model-infer" — and a KV-cache span when present. These are compatible with OpenTelemetry and will propagate through your existing tracing pipeline. Suggest adding semantic attributes: request_id, model_version, gpu_id, input_size.

- Dashboards: We'll import your Grafana panels and create a Redwood Console view with the following: latency heatmap, p50/p95/p99 lines, per-model token breakdown, error-class waterfall. Expect the import + layout to take 1 business day.

- Error taxonomy (proposed top-level buckets):
  * infra: resource exhaustion, OOM, disk pressure
  * serving: 4xx/5xx from runtime, model decode failure
  * correctness: hallucination/regression signals (for later evaluative routing)

- Alert routing: we can configure PD for critical, email + CS for high, and create Jira tickets for medium. The PD escalation policy will mirror your existing on-call rotations if you provide the PD policy ID.

I'll open SUP-1234 for the import and aim to have drafts of the 8 runbooks in our shared drive by EOD Friday.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
[References: JIRA SUP-1234]
